challenges.instruction: A thirsty customer wants a small cup of lemonade that costs 12¢. Drag the correct coins to make 12¢!
challenges.hint: Try using one dime (10¢) and two pennies (1¢ each) to reach 12¢.

challenges.instruction: A cheerful neighbor buys a glass for 20¢. Make 20¢ using your coins!
challenges.hint: You can use two dimes (10¢ + 10¢) or four nickels to make 20¢.

challenges.instruction: Another customer orders a big glass of lemonade for 35¢. Show 35¢ with your coins!
challenges.hint: Start with a quarter (25¢) and add a dime (10¢) to make 35¢.

challenges.instruction: Your friend buys lemonade and a cookie for 42¢. Can you make 42¢?
challenges.hint: Try one quarter (25¢), one dime (10¢), one nickel (5¢), and two pennies (2¢)!

challenges.instruction: A group of kids buys snacks for 68¢. Make 68¢ using your coins!
challenges.hint: Use two quarters (50¢), one dime (10¢), one nickel (5¢), and three pennies (3¢).

challenges.instruction: The final customer gives a big order totaling 89¢! Make 89¢ to close the stand for the day.
challenges.hint: Try three quarters (75¢), one dime (10¢), and four pennies (4¢).
